en.tagline: Make talking head and avatar videos with the belt CLI
en.summary: This skill creates AI avatar and talking head videos from a portrait image. You provide a script or an audio file, and it returns a video of the person speaking. It runs through the inference.sh belt CLI and includes several models.
problem: Making a talking presenter video usually means recording a person, or handling a separate text-to-speech tool and a lipsync tool. Each step adds files and setup.
With this skill, one portrait image and a voice script are enough. P-Video-Avatar can generate the speech and the lipsync in one run, so you skip the separate audio step for most jobs.
fit: Product demos, explainers and marketing videos with an AI presenter
UGC-style ads made from a single portrait image
Dubbing an existing video into another language with new audio
unfit: You cannot install the belt CLI or log in to inference.sh
You need to edit a video on a timeline rather than generate avatar clips
steps: Install the belt CLI and run `belt login`.
Choose a model: P-Video-Avatar for most jobs, OmniHuman 1.5 for images with several people, or Fabric 1.0 and PixVerse Lipsync for other lipsync cases.
Pass a portrait image URL plus either a `voice_script` with a built-in voice, or an `audio` URL.
Optionally add `voice_prompt`, `video_prompt`, `voice_language` or `resolution` to control tone, body language, background and output size.
Run `belt app run` with the app ID. The P-Video-Avatar output keeps the aspect ratio of the input image.
For models without built-in TTS, generate speech first with a text-to-speech app such as `inworld/text-to-speech-2`, then pass its audio URL to the avatar model.

zh.tagline: 用 belt CLI 生成数字人与口播视频
zh.summary: 这个技能可以根据一张人像图片生成 AI 数字人和口播视频。你提供文案或音频文件，它会返回一段人物说话的视频。它通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 运行，内置多个模型。
problem: 制作口播讲解视频，通常要真人录制，或者分别使用语音合成工具和口型同步工具。每个步骤都会增加文件和配置工作。
使用这个技能时，一张人像图和一段配音文案通常就够了。大多数情况下，P-Video-Avatar 可以在一次运行中同时生成语音和口型同步，不需要单独的音频步骤。
fit: 产品演示、讲解视频和带 AI 主播的营销视频
只用一张人像图制作的 UGC 风格广告
用新音频为已有视频做多语言配音
unfit: 无法安装 belt CLI 或登录 inference.sh
需要在时间线上编辑视频，而不是生成数字人片段
steps: 安装 belt CLI，并运行 `belt login`。
选择模型：大多数情况用 P-Video-Avatar；画面中有多人时用 OmniHuman 1.5；其他口型同步需求可用 Fabric 1.0 或 PixVerse Lipsync。
提供人像图片的 URL，以及带内置音色的 `voice_script`，或者一个 `audio` 音频 URL。
可选地加入 `voice_prompt`、`video_prompt`、`voice_language` 或 `resolution`，用来控制语气、肢体动作、背景和输出尺寸。
用应用 ID 运行 `belt app run`。P-Video-Avatar 的输出会保持输入图片的宽高比。
对于没有内置语音合成的模型，先用 `inworld/text-to-speech-2` 等语音合成应用生成语音，再把得到的音频 URL 传给数字人模型。
